sanskrit_verse:
पुत्राभावे तु दुहिता तुल्यसंतानदर्शनात्
पुत्रश्च दुहिता चोक्तौ पितुः संतानकारकौ
transliteration:
putrābhāve tu duhitā tulyasaṃtānadarśanāt
putraśca duhitā coktau pituḥ saṃtānakārakau
sph_interpretive_translation: In the absence of a son, a daughter is declared equal in the capacity to sustain lineage, as both son and daughter are declared by the father to be the generators of his lineage.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from conscious declaration, not biological default
Causation is established through intentional designation, not birth alone
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by ontological alignment, not gender
Restoration logic prioritizes continuity of dharma-vāha (dharma-carrying lineage)
Consciousness alignment supersedes social convention in determining legal capacity
executable_legal_axioms: IF lineage_continuity_claim EXISTS AND designated_lineage_bearer IS ABSENT THEN designated_alternate_lineage_bearer ASSUMES EQUAL_JURIDICAL_CAPACITY
IF father DECLARES child AS lineage_bearer THEN that child IS lineage_bearer REGARDLESS OF GENDER
IF no male_issue THEN female_issue RETAINS FULL_INHERITANCE_AND_LINEAGE_DUTY_BY_DEFAULT
ALL lineage_bearers MUST BE recognized BY_DECLARATION NOT BY_BIRTH_AUTOMATISM
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court shall recognize that filial capacity is determined by conscious investiture, not patriarchal default; where testamentary or declarative act assigns lineage-bearing role, such assignment overrides statutory assumptions based on gender or primogeniture.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through verbal assertion (śabda-pramāṇa) of the father; anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential assumption of duty upon vacancy; proportional responsibility aligns with declared capacity; non-punitive reality rule holds that exclusion from inheritance causes disalignment, not moral failure.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Lineage-integrity completion process: Realign assets and titles according to declared capacity
Responsibility assumption protocol: Daughter assumes full santāna-dharma upon invocation of tulyasamtāna declaration
Capacity restoration mechanism: Legal system must reflect declared spiritual-economic function, not conventional attribution
Integrity reintegration pathway: Family structure realigned to reflect conscious succession choice
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law restores Dharma as consciousness-invested succession, upholds the father's word as pramāṇa, abolishes punitive neglect of daughters, and establishes reality as non-gendered in the domain of santāna-karma. Thus is Dharma executed.
